note: Gate proposals for the first Cryptocurrency batch (owner's choice, 2026-10-10). Proposals only: read by no server code, not in catalog.ts, not listed by discover_apis, not callable. Every value below was written from the authoring session's memory, because the sandbox cannot reach the providers or their documentation: each is UNVERIFIED until a person checks it against the official documentation and signs it off (gates 1 and 2), the terms are read (gate 3), and a recorded answer passes the probe (gates 4 and 6). The found_2026_10_10 entries come from web-search summaries on 2026-10-10 (the providers' sites do not resolve from the sandbox); they say where to look, they are not verification.

proposals.check_first: The keyless v2 API may have been retired in favour of a keyed v3 (rest.coincap.io); if so, this API fails the keyless criterion of the batch and should be dropped or re-classified as api_key.

found_2026_10_10.summary: The keyless v2 API appears to be gone: a migration guide says api.coincap.io no longer resolves (NXDOMAIN), and that v3 (rest.coincap.io/v3) answers 401 without a key, with paid credits since 2025. If confirmed, CoinCap fails the keyless criterion of this batch: drop it, or reclassify it as api_key outside this batch.
found_2026_10_10.reliability: second-hand (a competitor's guide and third-party READMEs); no CoinCap announcement found

proposals.check_first: The free tier's request limit and whether attribution is required.

found_2026_10_10.summary: The free tier at api.coinpaprika.com/v1 works without a key for most endpoints. Its limit is stated two ways in its own docs (20,000 requests a month; 1,000 a day without a key). One third party says a public or commercial instance needs an enterprise agreement; no official attribution rule found.
found_2026_10_10.reliability: search summary of CoinPaprika's docs; the commercial-use line is second-hand

probe.success: HTTP 200, JSON, an array whose first item has coins_count

proposals.check_first: The trailing slash in its paths, and the stated request limit.

found_2026_10_10.summary: No key needed. No official terms page or published rate limit found; third parties suggest about one request per second and caching. Endpoint paths differ between sources (/api/tickers/ and /api/ticker/), so the probe path must be checked live.

probe.success: HTTP 200, JSON, an array of objects with name and tvl

proposals.check_first: Response sizes: some endpoints (for example /protocols) may exceed the gateway's 1 MiB default; the probe uses a small one. Also the split between the free and the paid (pro) API.

found_2026_10_10.summary: The free API at api.llama.fi needs no key. DefiLlama's own Pro page gives the open tier 10 to 200 requests a minute (Pro: 1,000 a minute, paid). The /v2/chains path was not confirmed by any result.
found_2026_10_10.reliability: rate limit from DefiLlama's own page (search summary); the rest second-hand

proposals.check_first: Several endpoints answer plain text (for example the tip height), which the gateway refuses (JSON only); the probe uses a JSON one. Also the public instance's rate limit.

found_2026_10_10.summary: Public endpoints need no key; the docs say rate limiting applies and point to a rate-limits page that was not found. One comparison site says about 10 requests a second. No terms of service found. /api/v1/fees/recommended is the mainnet path.
